synopsis: This multipurpose book features 52 word search puzzles with Star Wars themes accompanied by intricate artwork from all nine episodes in the Skywalker Saga--from The Phantom Menace to The Rise of Skywalker. With themes that include favorite characters and locations, this is the ideal activity book to have with you whether you're in the mood for a puzzle or some quiet time for coloring--or both!
title: Word Search and Coloring Book
